blocks.text: Cebu, Philippines – Optum Philippines, a leading healthcare global capability center (GCC), inaugurated its expanded workplace at Filinvest Cyberzone Cebu Tower 4 on August 20, 2026. The new site highlights the company’s commitment to investing in local talent through expanded operations and employee wellness facilities. Spread across five floors—with three fully operational and two opening soon—the facility positions Optum for continued growth while placing workforce well-being at the core of its strategy. This expansion opens specialized career opportunities across clinical care, revenue cycle management, technology, AI/ML, and shared services.
